dimensions.assessment: Affects La Paz County, local federal land management offices, and neighboring Colorado River Indian Tribes.
dimensions.evidence: convey approximately 3,400 acres of identified land managed by the Bureau of Land Management to the county

dimensions.assessment: Facilitates local land ownership transfer for potential future solar energy and job creation projects while requiring fair market payment.
dimensions.evidence: La Paz County Solar Energy and Job Creation Act

dimensions.assessment: Requires the county to pay fair market value and administrative costs; proceeds are deposited into the Federal Land Disposal Account.
dimensions.evidence: pay an amount equal to the appraised value... and all costs related to the conveyance

dimensions.assessment: Applies a specific one-time land conveyance exemption and mineral withdrawal for a defined 3,400-acre tract.
dimensions.evidence: withdrawn from the operation of the mining and mineral leasing laws of the United States

dimensions.assessment: Permanent transfer of land ownership and permanent mineral withdrawal.

missing_information: The precise dollar value of the land's appraisal and total administrative costs are not specified in the text.
importance_detail.rationale: Directs the Secretary of the Interior to convey approximately 3,400 acres of BLM land to La Paz County, Arizona, for fair market value, subject to resource exclusions and tribal protections.
